say:1:1736503001:0.text: Your Grace, I've found a serious buyer for your estate!
say:1:1736503001:0.source_cn: 公爵大人，这位客人对您的宅邸非常有兴趣，而且财力雄厚！

say:2:1736503002:0.text: Oh, is that so? Well, I won't sell to one of those vulgar upstarts...
say:2:1736503002:0.source_cn: 哦？是吗？只要不是那些暴发户……<key:dialog1>

say:5:1736503004:0.text: Good heavens! The great mage who saved Savannah is interested in my house?! What an extraordinary honor for my family!
say:5:1736503004:0.source_cn: 天哪！举世闻名的大魔法师，赛凡纳的拯救者，您居然看上了...
say:5:1736503004:0.male: Good heavens! The great mage who saved Savannah is interested in my house?! What an extraordinary honor for my family!
say:5:1736503004:0.female: Good heavens! The great mage who saved Savannah is interested in my house?! What an extraordinary honor for my family!

choice_prompt:6:1736503004.text: Good heavens! The great mage who saved Savannah is interested in my house?! What an extraordinary honor for my family!
choice_prompt:6:1736503004.source_cn: 天哪！举世闻名的大魔法师，赛凡纳的拯救者，您居然看上了我的房子？这可是韦恩家族莫大的荣幸啊！
choice_prompt:6:1736503004.male: Good heavens! The great mage who saved Savannah is interested in my house?! What an extraordinary honor for my family!
choice_prompt:6:1736503004.female: Good heavens! The great mage who saved Savannah is interested in my house?! What an extraordinary honor for my family!

say:7:1736503005:0.text: One million? That's for other buyers! It's unbecoming to talk money with you!
say:7:1736503005:0.source_cn: 百万？那都是卖给别人的！跟您谈钱也太伤感情了！
say:7:1736503005:0.male: One million? That's for other buyers! It's unbecoming to talk money with you!
say:7:1736503005:0.female: One million? That's for other buyers! It's unbecoming to talk money with you!

say:8:1736503006:0.text: For you, just ten thousand gold. Consider it a gesture of goodwill!
say:8:1736503006:0.source_cn: 这样吧，意思一下，一万金币，就当我们交个朋友！
say:8:1736503006:0.male: For you, just ten thousand gold. Consider it a gesture of goodwill!
say:8:1736503006:0.female: For you, just ten thousand gold. Consider it a gesture of goodwill!

say:9:1736503007:0.text: The bragging rights I'll get from this are worth far more than a million gold!
say:9:1736503007:0.source_cn: 以后我跟别人说是梅林阁下看中了我的房子，这面子可比一百...
say:9:1736503007:0.male: The bragging rights I'll get from this are worth far more than a million gold!
say:9:1736503007:0.female: The bragging rights I'll get from this are worth far more than a million gold!

say:12:1736503009:0.text: Alright, I'll get the contract ready...
say:12:1736503009:0.source_cn: 好吧，我立刻为两位准备合同……
